ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to the distal tips and specific linear/mottled scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black field. High-contrast white mottling is concentrated on the far lateral edge of the left lobe. A single high-intensity focal spot is visible on the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 80 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys at the distal tips; trailing edge transitions to lower-frequency, shallower irregularities moving toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep; curves are predominantly convex toward the tips with a slight concave transition originating from the notch area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, high-contrast diagonal linear mark (rake mark) on the upper right lobe; several thinner, fainter parallel linear disruptions are detectable on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear diagonal scar on the right lobe; extensive tattered/jagged structural loss at the distal extremities of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white pixel grouping on the far left edge forming a unique irregular pattern against the dark fluke body.
